c6b3dc8d3f428c78.title: Peter & the Wolf — with the Angeles Symphony Orchestra
c6b3dc8d3f428c78.desc: The Angeles Symphony Orchestra, presented by the Salit Foundation, is delighted to return to the Burbank Public Library for a special family performance of Prokofiev’s beloved Peter and the Wolf . Led by Maestro James Yongjae Kim and featuring live narration, this engaging 30-minute concert introduces children and families to the instruments of the orchestra through one of classical music’s most imaginative and enduring stories! The Salit Foundation is a Burbank-based nonprofit dedicated to empowering artists, strengthening communities, and making exceptional musical experiences accessible to all. As part of its commitment to the Burbank community, the Foundation presents an annual free children’s concert, creating opportunities for young audiences to experience the excitement and wonder of live classical music. This is a free event. This program is supported in part by a Community Events and Program Grant from the City of Burbank.

c6b354a6baf845dc.title: Camarillo Farmers Market
c6b354a6baf845dc.desc: The Camarillo Certified Farmers Market is sponsored by Livingston Memorial Visiting Nurse Association & Hospice—proceeds from the market support free grief & bereavement programs throughout the county. The Farmers Market takes place every Saturday from 8 a.m. until noon . The market is located at 2222 Ventura Boulevard in Old Town, Camarillo. Plenty of free parking is available. In addition to the freshest fruits and vegetables, you’ll find home-kitchen baked goods, freshly baked bread, cookies, & pastries, jam, beef jerky, honey, nuts & dried fruit, organic eggs, fresh flowers & live garden plants, hummus & salsa, pasta & sauce, fresh local seafood, seasoning blends for dips, marinades, and rubs, microgreens, mushrooms, tamales, yogurt, and sausage.

Grab your seats now for Mark Paul and make it a night out worth talking about.

c60e09497d0d7489.title: Edward Scissorhands in Concert
c60e09497d0d7489.desc: Edward Scissorhands in Concert with CSUN Symphony John Roscigno, conductor TWO PERFORMANCES: Sat Dec 5 | 7PM Sun Dec 6 | 3PM Step into the shadowy, surreal universe of Tim Burton’s Edward Scissorhands, where whimsy walks hand-in-hand with holiday magic. CSUN Symphony brings Danny Elfman’s hauntingly beautiful score to life, performing live with Conductor John Roscigno. Lose yourself in the stunning visuals and heartfelt storytelling of this off-kilter modern fairy tale, following Edward (Johnny Depp) and Kim (Winona Ryder) in the story of the gentle outsider with scissors for hands as he navigates love, friendship, family, and the bittersweet challenges of fitting in.
